title: Distinguish ownership from resource coordination
when: When concurrent work needs a declared shared resource or a holder conflict appears.
need: Identify whether the hold owns an item, steering scope, process or resource; preserve the real owner and use the declared handoff/release path.
gap: Existing map traces path overlaps and steering, but not every non-path coordination scenario. Review question: should JOURNEYS show resource-busy recovery as a branch rather than teaching all claims during installation?
